content: Explore User/RewardPointLog models, auth (register + Google), checkout order-complete + crypto-paid paths, rewards routes/frontend
Rewards core: add idempotent point helpers + RewardPointLog reference field (welcome/order/referral); central award logic
Welcome $5 (250 pts): grant once on signup (email + Google) with idempotency flag
Welcome back-fill: one-time script to grant 250 pts to all existing users (idempotent)
Per-order earn: award 0.5 pt/$1 of amount paid on order completion (wallet + crypto), idempotent per order
Referral: User fields + code/link, signup ref capture, award 250 pts to both on referee's first paid order
Frontend: referral link/code UI + welcome/earn reflected in rewards banner & rewards history
Test end-to-end with testing agent (welcome grant, order earn, referral, backfill) + fix issues
